description: Hi! I am Sachin Prasad, a Computer Science student and a relentless builder who lives at the intersection of high-level application design and low-level system performance.

My toolkit ranges from crafting cross-platform mobile experiences with Flutter and Dart to designing digital logic with Verilog and experimenting with ESP32 hardware projects. Whether I'm writing Python scripts to automate my workflow or building web apps, I'm driven by the 'how it works' as much as the 'how it looks.'

When I'm not in a code editor, I’m likely rice-ing my Arch Linux (Hyprland) setup, documenting my Java and Flutter journey on GitHub, or diving into a high-stakes thriller. I believe the best digital experiences are built by those who aren't afraid to break things and rebuild them better.
